aboutGame.title: What is Project Rasengan?
paragraphs: Project Rasengan is a Naruto-inspired action RPG built around fast ninja combat, hand-sign jutsu, and mobility that rewards practice. You create a fighter, learn chakra-driven abilities, run ranked missions, and test your build against other players in real time.

Progression layers character levels, jutsu mastery, stat points, and a mission rank ladder on top of PvP arenas, boss encounters, and daily quests. Our wiki covers every system with beginner guides, keybind references, skill builds, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Project Rasengan.

items.question: What is Project Rasengan?
items.answer: Project Rasengan is a Naruto-inspired action RPG on Roblox. You build a shinobi, learn chakra-driven jutsu, run ranked missions, and fight other players in real-time combat.

items.question: What controls does Project Rasengan use?
items.answer: Project Rasengan supports keyboard and mouse, controller, and touch. Movement and camera are separate inputs, abilities sit on number keys or face buttons, and dash or dodge is the most important bind to master.

items.question: How do Project Rasengan codes work?
items.answer: Project Rasengan codes are short strings the developers release to grant free currency, XP boosts, cosmetics, or rerolls. Enter them in the redemption field from the main menu, type them by hand, and redeem on the account you actually play.

items.question: What is the fastest way to level up in Project Rasengan?
items.answer: Layer your XP sources: finish story quests early, grind enemies you can kill in two or three hits, bank dailies, and group up for boss runs once they unlock.

items.question: Which Project Rasengan character should I pick?
items.answer: Pick by role, not just rarity. A mid-rarity fighter that fills a missing role usually outperforms a flashy high-rarity pull, so check the ability kit, element, and team fit before investing.

items.question: How does the Project Rasengan rank system work?
items.answer: Ranks gate the content you can access. Each promotion unlocks stronger jutsu, higher mission tiers, better shops, and separate PvP brackets, so climbing steadily matters more than grinding one activity.
